907-1479-8338.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Shuttlecraft Galileo, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger, creating a 1/1 red Officer creature token
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Shuttlecraft Galileo trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2459-5006-7272-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2459-5006-7272-8170.notablePrerequisites: You have at least four card types in your graveyard.
2459-5006-7272-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Reaper of Flight Moonsilver by sacrificing Rograkh, giving Reaper of Flight Moonsilver +2/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4460-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-4460-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4460-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

147-653-4247.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
147-653-4247.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Holding priority, activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage, giving Bloodthrone Vampire +2/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-5007-6972.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

586-728-2906-5258-5618.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has lost life this turn.
586-728-2906-5258-5618.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Gives +1/+1 counter to creatures that enter

2511-3197-6566--196.description:
Cast Herd Baloth by paying its mana cost.
When Herd Baloth enters, the effect that adds +1/+1 counters to entering creatures triggers or applies its replacement effect, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, that same effect causes you to place at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Yuna triggers, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth
Repeat steps 3 and 4 once.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat from step 5.

1594-1621-6867-7056.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

5115-7420-7546.description:
Cast a copy of Maestro's Gift from exile by paying {3}{U}{R}.
When you cast that spell, Molten-Core Maestro triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself and adding an amount of {R} equal to its power.
Maestro's Gift resolves, creating a copy of Inspired Skypainter who enters prepared and with haste.
If needed, activate Gemstone Array by paying {R}{R}, adding {U}
Repeat, adding an ever-increasing amount of {R} in step 2.

586-2511-4871-5258-5618.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rakdos trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {3}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

4089-5282-7149.description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Put Glasspool Mimic into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Glasspool Mimic dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as a land named Moon. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Wormfang Newt, gaining its abilities.
When Glasspool Mimic enters, its first ability triggers, exiling it.
When Glasspool Mimic leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Glasspool Mimic from exile to the battlefield. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Princess Yue.
Repeat from step 2.

141-1532-6797.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-1532-6797.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2231-4659-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
2231-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3918-4038-4045.description:
Activate Trazyn using Ur-Golem's Eye's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Trazyn using Farmstead Gleaner's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on Trazyn.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature except Terra

969-6575-6685.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, creating a token copy of Mesmerizing Dose.
When the Mesmerizing Dose token enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a lore counter on Esper Terra.
Repeat from step 2 two additional times, from Esper Terra's second and third chapter abilities triggering.
Esper Terra's fourth chapter ability triggers, causing you to add {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, and then exile Esper Terra and return it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
When Terra, Magical Adept enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2961-5231-6553.easyPrerequisites: False Demise attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
2961-5231-6553.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, False Demise triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning False Demise from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Repeat.

4484-4871-6441-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4484-4871-6441-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating two 2/2 Zombie Druid creature tokens.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

618-2511-3742.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Phantom Steed.
When the Phantom Steed token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Phantom Steed leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Phantom Steed token.
When the Phantom Steed token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

618-1734-2921.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Fiend Hunter.
When the Fiend Hunter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Fiend Hunter leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Fiend Hunter token.
When the Fiend Hunter token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

710-1052-2034.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Danitha, adding {C}{C}.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Repeat.

2136-3562.notablePrerequisites:
Orthion does not have summoning sickness.
Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {1}{R}.
2136-3562.description:
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {1}{R}.
Activate Orthion's first ability by paying {1}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Sky Hussar with haste.
When the Sky Hussar token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping all creatures you control.
Repeat.

2558-2921-5687-5690.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Ruination Guide, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3946-4426-5033.description:
Play Glacial Chasm either from your hand or from your graveyard.
When Glacial Chasm enters the battlefield, its second ability triggers, causing you to sacrifice another land you control.
Play any land from your graveyard.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Glacial Chasm's cumulative upkeep ability triggers, allowing you to choose not to pay the cost and sacrifice it instead.
Repeat.

2060-2589-4013-4929.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Ridgescale Tusker.
Ridgescale Tusker enters the battlefield, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2018-3025-4050-5197.description:
Activate Downdraft by paying {G}, causing Luminous Broodmoth to lose flying until end of turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Luminous Broodmoth, adding {G}.
Bastion of Remembrance triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and causing you to gain 1 life.
Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Repeat.

2334-2556-4872.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
